en-US.description: 🐱 Cross-platform desktop pet BongoCat, adding fun to your desktop!
en-US.longDescription:
🐱 Cross-platform desktop pet BongoCat, adding fun to your desktop!
Features:
- Compatible with macOS, Windows, and Linux (x11).
- Synchronizes mouse movements or keyboard taps based on your keyboard or mouse actions.
- Supports importing custom models to freely create your unique cat avatar.
- Fully open-source with transparent code—absolutely no user data collection.
- Works offline—no internet required, ensuring user privacy.
en-US.releaseNotes:
✨ Features
- Added a "Model window → Window behavior → Hide when idle" setting.
- Added a "Model window → Window behavior → Idle hide delay" setting.
- Added a "Model window → Window behavior → Hold a modifier key to interact" setting.
- Added an "Input & interaction → Mouse → Force mouse movement" setting.
- Added a "Model behavior → Turn off an expression when triggered again" setting.
- Added renaming support to "Shortcuts → Model behavior shortcuts".
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed noticeable soft fringes around model texture edges.
- Fixed misplaced key images in some converted Bongo-Cat-Mver models.
🎨 Interface
- Renamed "App & system → Startup & desktop → Open at login" to "Run at startup".

zh-CN.description: 🐱 跨平台桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
zh-CN.longDescription:
🐱 跨平台桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
功能介绍
- 适配 macOS、Windows 和 Linux (x11)。
- 根据据键盘或鼠标操作，同步移动鼠标或敲击键盘。
- 支持导入自定义模型，自由打造专属猫咪形象。
- 完全开源，代码公开透明，绝不收集任何用户数据。
- 支持离线运行，无需联网，保护用户隐私。
zh-CN.name: BongoCat
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
✨ 新功能
- 新增「模型窗口 → 窗口行为 → 无操作时隐藏」配置项。
- 新增「模型窗口 → 窗口行为 → 无操作时隐藏延迟」配置项。
- 新增「模型窗口 → 窗口行为 → 按住修饰键进行交互」配置项。
- 新增「输入与交互 → 鼠标 → 强制移动鼠标」配置项。
- 新增「模型行为 → 重复触发同一表情时关闭它」配置项。
- 「快捷键 → 模型行为快捷键」支持重命名。
🐛 问题修复
- 修复模型纹理边缘出现明显羽化的问题。
- 修复部分 Bongo-Cat-Mver 模型转换后按键图显示错位的问题。
🎨 界面
- 将「应用与系统 → 启动与桌面 → 登录时启动」更名为「开机自启动」。
